direction.grid: 1366x768 full-viewport: 48px header, 40px compact horizontal rail, minmax(0,1fr) main, 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; enlarge rendered scene to at least 70% of main and condense side content inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22), silver #C5CCD4 headings, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary, emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable black, emerald and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px, header tabs spanning most of the header at at least 16px, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step, minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions tied only to real state; 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels, one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; no unrelated loops; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset, pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story preserves second required logo placement; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls, never conflating them; action bar Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval, blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG filling at least 70% of main with real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes emerald only, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text
